lines: By that scripture initiated indeed this free from restraint conduct doubting; not in main fit thus by other service would be but fitness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tacchāstradīkṣito hyeṣa niryantrācāraśaṅkitaḥ na mukhye yogya ityanyasevātaḥ syāttu yogyatā
